overview.description: The Eaton Vance Preferred Securities and Income ETF (EVPF) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests primarily in preferred securities and other income-producing instruments. The portfolio emphasizes preferred and hybrid securities, often issued by financial services companies, in pursuit of income and total return. EVPF was launched on Mar 3, 2026 and is issued by Eaton Vance.
